shortDescription: Create, update or delete an UptimeRobot monitor

options.name: alert_contacts
options.description: Alert contacts to attach to the monitor. Each item references an existing alert contact, plus the per-monitor I(threshold) and I(recurrence). The list is replaced on every run; pass an empty list to clear all attached contacts. When an item has I(id), it is used directly. Otherwise I(friendly_name) is resolved against C(getAlertContacts); an unknown name fails the play.

options.name: api_key
options.description: UptimeRobot API key. When unset, the module reads I(api_key_file) (default C(~/.uptimerobot)) and finally falls back to the C(UPTIMEROBOT_API_KEY) environment variable.

options.name: api_key_file
options.description: Path to a file whose first line is the UptimeRobot API key. Tilde-expanded.

options.name: custom_http_headers
options.description: Extra HTTP headers to send with each check. Accepts either a JSON-encoded string or a plain dict; the module forwards either form to UptimeRobot unchanged.

options.name: custom_http_statuses
options.description: Override of which HTTP status codes count as up/down, in UptimeRobot's wire format (e.g. C(200:0_201:0_500:1)). Only forwarded as-is.

options.name: disable_domain_expire_notifications
options.description: C(disable) silences UptimeRobot's domain-expiry warnings for this monitor, C(enable) keeps them on.

options.name: friendly_name
options.description: Display name of the monitor. Used as the idempotency key, so it must be unique on the account.

options.name: http_auth_type
options.description: Authentication scheme used together with I(http_username) and I(http_password). Like I(http_password), this is forwarded on every edit but never counted as a change because the API does not return it.

options.name: http_method
options.description: HTTP method to use for I(type=C(http)) and I(type=C(keyw)) monitors.

options.name: http_password
options.description: Password for HTTP basic / digest authentication. UptimeRobot does not return this field in C(getMonitors), so the module always forwards the value on edit but never counts it as a change.

options.name: http_username
options.description: Username for HTTP basic / digest authentication. Only meaningful for I(type=C(http)) and I(type=C(keyw)).

options.name: ignore_ssl_errors
options.description: When C(true), accept invalid or self-signed TLS certificates and only fail on connection-level errors.

options.name: interval
options.description: Check interval in seconds. UptimeRobot enforces a per-plan minimum (e.g. 30s on the Pro plan, 300s on the free plan).

options.name: keyword_case_type
options.description: For I(type=C(keyw)), C(cs) makes the search case-sensitive, C(ci) case-insensitive.

options.name: keyword_type
options.description: For I(type=C(keyw)), C(exist) alerts when the keyword is found in the response body, C(notex) alerts when it is missing.

options.name: keyword_value
options.description: Keyword to look for in the response body. Required for I(type=C(keyw)).

options.name: mwindows
options.description: Maintenance windows to attach to the monitor. Each item references an existing maintenance window. The list is replaced on every run; pass an empty list to detach all windows. When an item has I(id), it is used directly. Otherwise I(friendly_name) is resolved against C(getMWindows); an unknown name fails the play.

options.name: port
options.description: Custom port number. Only consulted by UptimeRobot when I(type=C(port)) and I(sub_type=C(custom)).

options.name: post_content_type
options.description: C(Content-Type) header for the request body.

options.name: post_type
options.description: Format of the I(post_value) payload.

options.name: post_value
options.description: Payload to send with C(POST) / C(PUT) / C(PATCH) requests.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) creates the monitor when missing, or updates it in place when present. C(absent) deletes the monitor identified by I(friendly_name). When the monitor does not exist, the module exits with C(changed=false).

options.name: status
options.description: C(up) un-pauses the monitor, C(paused) pauses it. Only honoured on edit; UptimeRobot rejects this field on create. To create a monitor in a paused state, create it first and then re-run the task with I(status=C(paused)).

options.name: sub_type
options.description: For I(type=C(port)), which protocol/port preset to use. C(custom) means "use the explicit I(port) value".

options.name: timeout
options.description: Per-check timeout in seconds.

options.name: type
options.description: Monitor type. C(http) for HTTP(S) checks, C(keyw) for keyword checks, C(ping) for ICMP, C(port) for TCP-port checks, C(beat) for heartbeat. Required when creating a new monitor. Only honoured on create; UptimeRobot rejects type changes on existing monitors.

options.name: url
options.description: URL, host, IP or heartbeat token to monitor. Required when creating a new monitor; ignored on update if unchanged.
